item.title: Crypto exchange suffers loss due to AI
item.description: The Moonwell cryptocurrency exchange lost nearly $2 million due to a technical glitch in its automated system, which uses artificial intelligence algorithms to set prices and execute transactions, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: German producer prices fall in January
item.description: Producer prices in Germany fell by 3% in January compared to the same month last year, according to a report released Friday by the country’s statistical office, Destatis. On a monthly basis, producer prices declined 0.6% compared to December 2025, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Sri Lanka proposes house arrest to reduce prison crowding
item.description: Sri Lanka’s government is preparing legislation that would allow courts to place suspects under house arrest instead of remanding them, aiming to ease the country’s severe prison overcrowding, a senior official said, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: China, Iran, Russia to hold Middle East drills
item.description: China, Iran, and Russia are set to conduct joint naval exercises in the Strait of Hormuz, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Poland bans Chinese cars from military facilities
item.description: The Chief of the General Staff of Poland, General Veslav Kukula, has decided to ban Chinese-made vehicles from entering protected military installations, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: NASA reports Starliner mission failure
item.description: NASA has released a detailed report on the failed Starliner mission, which resulted in two Boeing astronauts spending nine months aboard the International Space Station, far longer than the mission’s originally planned one-week duration.

item.title: Europe seeks energy independence as Azerbaijan advances Black Sea green power corridor
item.description: Technically, it would be among the longest and deepest subsea power cables constructed to date, requiring specialized manufacturing and installation capabilities. Onshore grid infrastructure, particularly in Georgia, would require upgrades to accommodate variable renewable flows at scale.

item.title: Zelensky rejects withdrawal from Donetsk as Russia demands full Donbas control
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has reaffirmed that Kyiv will not withdraw from the government-controlled areas of the Donetsk region, describing the territory as a critical defensive line for the country.

item.title: Azerbaijan reduces motor gasoline production in January
item.description: Azerbaijan produced 114.9 thousand tons of motor gasoline in January of this year, according to the State Statistical Committee, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan participates in 14th meeting of OTS Ministers of Economy and Trade
item.description: Azerbaijan’s Deputy Minister of Economy Rövnəq Abdullayev took part in the 14th Meeting of Ministers of Economy and Trade of the Turkic States Organization (OTS) held in the city of Türkistan, Kazakhstan.
